entities.summary: Henry Everett "Hank" Emerson was a United States Army lieutenant general. He is best known for having been the commander of the 2nd Infantry Division in South Korea during the mid-1970s, when Colin Powell served as a battalion commander. Emerson was a 1947 graduate of the United States Military Academy.
